Victory Capital Management Inc. Grows Position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Posted by Donald Scott | Jan 25th, 2018 
Victory Capital Management Inc. grew its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 7.5% in the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 562,098 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 39,390 shares during the quarter. Victory Capital Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $86,631,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also bought and sold shares of AAPL. Mosaic Family Wealth LLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 2.4% during the 3rd quarter. Mosaic Family Wealth LLC now owns 25,728 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,965,000 after buying an additional 597 shares during the last quarter. Rosenblum Silverman Sutton S F Inc. CA bought a new position in Apple during the third quarter worth $422,000. Northstar Wealth Partners LLC lifted its stake in Apple by 17.1% during the third quarter. Northstar Wealth Partners LLC now owns 19,055 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,969,000 after purchasing an additional 2,777 shares during the last quarter. Traynor Capital Management Inc. lifted its stake in Apple by 4.0% during the third quarter. Traynor Capital Management Inc. now owns 122,505 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $18,780,000 after purchasing an additional 4,692 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Vicus Capital increased its position in Apple by 1.1% in the third quarter. Vicus Capital now owns 37,892 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,840,000 after buying an additional 419 shares during the period. 60.20% of the stock is owned by hedge funds and other institutional investors. AAPL has been the topic of several analyst reports. Citigroup reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 13th. Drexel Hamilton reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $208.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 24th. Piper Jaffray Companies reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 target price (up from $196.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 31st. Vetr lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $171.48 target price on the stock. in a research report on Monday, October 30th. Finally, Nomura set a $185.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, November 27th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, twelve have issued a hold rating, thirty-seven have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock presently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $200.81. 
In other Apple news, insider Eduardo H. Cue sold 65,361 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Thursday, November 30th. The stock was sold at an average price of $171.60, for a total value of $11,215,947.60. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this hyperlink . Also, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Tuesday, November 14th. The stock was sold at an average price of $172.35, for a total value of $2,695,726.35. Following the sale, the insider now owns 39,682 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $6,839,192.70. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last ninety days, insiders sold 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155. 0.08% of the stock is owned by insiders. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) traded down $2.82 during midday trading on Thursday, reaching $174.22. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 51,213,699 shares, compared to its average volume of 28,121,727. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $120.28 and a 52 week high of $180.10. The company has a market cap of $888,130.00, a P/E ratio of 18.96, a P/E/G ratio of 1.43 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. Apple had a return on equity of 36.29% and a net margin of 21.09%. The company had revenue of $52.58 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $50.71 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $1.50 EPS. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.2% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.2 earnings per share for the current year. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
